methods_quotes.q: Nonadherence was measured using the proportion of days covered (PDC) metric
To align with current standards, beneficiaries with a PDC <80% were considered nonadherent
Among beneficiaries taking multiple antihypertensives, overall PDC was calculated as an average of the PDCs calculated for each therapeutic class.
